ecc.body:
# ECC 2.2.3

ECC 2.2.3 is a naming and release-reliability update. The project is called ECC
everywhere it ships, starting with the `pi/core` profile, and the release
workflow now waits long enough for npm to serve a freshly published version.

## Naming

- `pi/core` no longer expands the project name: its README and the bundled
  `blueprint` skill refer to ECC only. The profile contents are otherwise
  unchanged: 123 curated skills and 24 prompt commands, 35,006 characters of
  skill description text.
- Downstream packagers need no changes. The package is still `ecc-pi-core`, the
  directory is still `pi/core/`, and existing install paths keep working.

## Release workflow

- After `npm publish`, the release workflow polls the registry for up to five
  minutes before verifying the published artifact. In 2.2.2 it gave up after
  about 30 seconds while npm was still processing the upload, so the run failed
  before promoting `latest` and creating the GitHub Release, and had to be
  re-run.

Downstream consumption is unchanged: poll `/releases`, download
`archive/refs/tags/vX.Y.Z.tar.gz`, pin its sha256, copy `pi/core/`, and load it
offline.

ponytail.body:
This one cleans up the band. On Team, Enterprise and managed machines the warning on your first prompt is gone, and the band shows your model and session name again. In VS Code it stays on one line, other plugins' commands no longer print under ponytail's name, and the noisy "duplicate?" hint is gone.


## What's Changed
* fix(band): show the level again after /clear and /resume by @timofeevAV in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1161
* fix(map): raise the git ls-files buffer so large repos keep tracked files by @HyperionBurn in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1156
* ci: run agentic benchmark selftest in test workflow by @ml-lubich in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1154
* docs: clarify Cursor mode state scope by @Boulea7 in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1135
* fix(codex): small composer icon instead of the 554 KB logo by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1164
* fix(hooks): 15 s hook timeout so a slow node start on Windows keeps its output by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1165
* fix(hooks): give the codebase map 3 s so a slow Windows start keeps it by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1166
* fix(bench): wait for the killed todo server before the workdir cleanup by @devohmycode in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1116
* fix(band): find the transcript without a classic hook by @trhinehart-attentive in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1242
* fix(band): watch only /clear, /resume and /branch, so other plugins' output is not labelled ponytail by @ph3on1x in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1291
* fix(band): size the row to bodyColumns only in the terminal by @lelmarir in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1302
* fix(band): drop the duplicate? hint, count only project files, tighter details view by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1305
* chore: release v5.3.3 by @DietrichGebert in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1307

## New Contributors
* @timofeevAV made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1161
* @HyperionBurn made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1156
* @ml-lubich made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1154
* @trhinehart-attentive made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1242
* @ph3on1x made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1291
* @lelmarir made their first contribution in https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail/pull/1302

hyperframes.body:
# HyperFrames v0.9.14

Released on 2026-11-04.

Cloud renders no longer fail on common font styles, and they now carry the system fonts a project uses. A wedged render stops itself, and `check` no longer hangs on long videos.

## Features

- **CLI:** Cloud render carries the system fonts a project uses in its zip ([cba66f20a69c9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cba66f20a69c9e929564a756852dac71c4c437de), [#7165](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7165)).

## Fixes

- **CLI:** Tell a failed billing checkout apart from a payment not finished in time ([60ca970ed60df](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/60ca970ed60df041e95f7d9194561e412bbbaf45), [#7185](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7185)).
- **Fonts:** Stop failing cloud renders on var() shorthands, font-X-400 names and linked font sheets ([af0c815c72b14](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/af0c815c72b14bb3d70f6ef762012e87927dff6b), [#7166](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7166)).
- **CLI:** Check copies only the stretch of a video it plays and stops after 2 minutes of copies ([c6f87f59b0c9a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c6f87f59b0c9ab17fc704aa8609cfee5294a3951), [#7182](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7182)).
- **CLI:** Report why a reverse session could not be recorded ([21e2038595047](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/21e2038595047a1ab2dfb2c79489acbb7c94d519), [#7186](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7186)).
- **CLI:** Check thins its craft samples when frames are slow, so the pass ends near 90 seconds ([be8122d0c4054](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/be8122d0c4054c785fddb277b330267555080cd0), [#7183](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7183)).
- **CLI:** A command waiting on the project lock says what it waits for ([00ea86570a8c8](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/00ea86570a8c8dc60c66bb6018b4826844cac6a0), [#7184](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7184)).
- **Engine:** A background image that never finishes decoding no longer stalls the frame ([73e65e2c7826b](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/73e65e2c7826ba1e33382f1f09d66f4e115e3aaa), [#6972](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/6972)).
- **CLI:** A track with no beats answers an empty result, not an error ([cffd70f2f9b24](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cffd70f2f9b24475de0b772f028361cca7c0d551), [#7173](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7173)).
- **Core:** A logo image no longer renders stretched to the frame bottom ([3d78ac0fa6671](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/3d78ac0fa6671c31ba69186d084951aeb8dc8e18), [#7179](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7179)).
- **CLI:** A wedged render trips its 60 s watchdog, one local render at a time, and fonts the cloud can't resolve are flagged ([d4e4b07e3cbc1](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d4e4b07e3cbc101eae5d1a59d858a113ea1cf6f1), [#7168](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7168)).

## Docs & Examples

- **Nav:** The docs menu button names the section you are in ([054cf4f119a76](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/054cf4f119a769615a1c8ab8534a03447f914a01), [#7133](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7133)).
- Drop the hidden add-a-transition button; hand-off now works on windows and linux ([97b805dcbdb11](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/97b805dcbdb119454510ea3b10f8b5fa173b0ab1), [#7132](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7132)).
- Say HyperFrames is free, and what the Studio app's Pro plan adds ([c3eb052545668](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c3eb052545668af14ab7578f964c5e7dacfdc6ce), [#7131](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7131)).

## Catalog

- **Catalog:** A search box over the cards; it fills the ?q= filter the gallery already reads ([b2b034fcd88f9](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b2b034fcd88f95dc52377279d556a9a8e3434885), [#7147](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7147)).

## Internal

- **Studio:** The studio-open journey counts the same thumbnails on every runner image ([2f321e0b0bb13](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2f321e0b0bb13eedefe3f8d206df33956347a809), [#7187](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7187)).
- **Studio:** The timeline viewport gate runs one pinned Chrome build, not the runner's ([2679bcdee71aa](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/2679bcdee71aa0b1d706fd845f399fa07fc2c48f), [#7180](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/7180)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.9.13...v0.9.14

superpowers.body:
This release further tunes brainstorming's questions. It asks fewer of them, starts by asking why, and when there's a choice to make it gives you options to pick from. It also fixes bootstrap problems on six harnesses, and makes the SDD and executing-plans helper scripts much harder to point at the wrong repository or the wrong task.

### Brainstorming

- **It asks a question only when the answer would change what gets built and nothing already answers it.** Otherwise it states its call as a proposal you can correct. It also stops asking about process: writing things up, where files go, whether to look further, and how to show you something are its own calls, and it tells you what it decided. (#2644)
- **When you haven't said why you want something, that's the first thing it asks.** It asks openly, with no example answers to pick from. (#2644)
- **When there's a choice it can name, it shows you the options with a recommendation.** In one of our test scenarios, where a spec gives Ctrl+K to two features, 7.0.1 found the conflict every time but asked a bare "which one?" in 8 of 8 runs. This release laid out the options and recommended one in 8 of 8. (#2644)
- **It reads from how you talk whether you want to discuss the technical choices,** and when your request leaves nothing open, its first message is a short design for you to approve. (#2644)
- In blind-graded test conversations, filler questions dropped from 41 with 7.0.1 to 23, the reason behind the request came out before any approach in 33 of 33 conversations (28 of 33 before), and nothing got built before approval (4 times before). Against 6.4.2's brainstorming in the same scenarios, it had fewer filler questions (23 against 34), drew out the why far more often (33 of 33 against 19 of 33), and matched it at building nothing before approval. (#2644)
- **`start-server.sh --project-dir .` now works.** The script `cd`s into its own directory before starting the server, so every path it derived from a relative `--project-dir` pointed to the wrong place, and the server never started. It now resolves the directory first. Thanks @anchore-jesset for the report. (#2524, #2608)

Thanks to @mbcrawfo and everyone on #2530 who sent transcripts and tested 7.0.1. If brainstorming still asks you something it shouldn't, please tell us there, with what you asked and what it asked back.

### Hooks

- **Copilot on Windows now gets the bootstrap.** Copilot CLI and VS Code Copilot run hook commands through PowerShell, which rejected the SessionStart command with a ParserError. `hooks.json` now has a `powershell` form of the command. Thanks @ronpieper-engcp and @orty for the reports. (#2189, #1225, #2592)
- **The SessionStart hook starts no child processes.** On Git Bash, each one costs tens of milliseconds, and the hook started six of them on every startup, `/clear` and compaction. Thanks @midirectiekade14-debug for the report and measurements. (#2081, #2593)
- **On a Unix system without bash, `run-hook.cmd` falls back to zsh, or exits quietly.** It used to exit 127 with `bash: not found`, and the bootstrap was lost. (#2503, #2594)

### Pi

- **Every prompt now gets the bootstrap.** The extension turned the bootstrap off after the first prompt of a session, so every later prompt went without it. Because the first message of the request changed, Anthropic prompt caching also rewrote the whole conversation's cache on the second prompt. Over a day of sessions, @sjawhar measured 83% of first-to-second-prompt transitions rewriting the cache. Thanks @DKnight927 for the report. (#2083, #2595)
- **The `skills` filter on the Superpowers package entry works.** The extension re-added the whole `skills/` directory after pi applied the filter, so `"skills": []` still loaded all 15 skills. Thanks @adrian-85 for the report and @m2dumpling for the fix. (#2394, #2402, #2598)

### Hermes Agent

- **`delegate_task` subagents no longer get the controller's bootstrap.** Every child started with an empty history, so each one looked like a new session and got the full bootstrap, and some started by loading `using-superpowers` instead of doing their task. Thanks @thealps01-netizen for the report. (#2536, #2596)

### OpenCode

- **The bootstrap tells the model to use bare skill ids.** OpenCode registers skills as `brainstorming`, not `superpowers:brainstorming`, so a model that copied the namespaced form from the bootstrap got "skill not found" and went on without the skill. Thanks @shiluoluo16 for the report. (#2583, #2597)
- **A prompt that mentions `EXTREMELY_IMPORTANT` no longer turns the bootstrap off.** The plugin decided the bootstrap was already there if the first message contained that word, so asking "is there an EXTREMELY_IMPORTANT block in your context?" was enough to drop it. It now looks for the bootstrap's own first line. Thanks @Swift22 for the report. (#2197, #2600)
- **OpenCode 2's compaction and generate requests carry the bootstrap.** Without it, the compaction request, the largest of the session, missed the prompt cache. Thanks @tpischke for the report and measurements. (#2391, #2601)

### Muse

- **The SessionStart hook now runs on Debian and Ubuntu.** Muse's manifest ran `hooks/session-start`, a bash script, with `sh`. Where `sh` is dash, the hook failed with exit 2 and the bootstrap never loaded. It now runs with `bash`. Thanks @rahul05ranjan for the report and @twotnguyen for the fix. (#2528, #2533)

### Subagent-Driven Development and Executing Plans

- **The helpers act on the repository of the current directory, as `git` does, and take `-C DIR` to point at another.** Outside a repository, `sdd-workspace` used to write its workspace into whatever directory the agent was in, often the plugin cache. All five helpers now stop with exit 2 and a message that tells your agent what to do. In a new project with no commits yet, your agent will need to run `git init` and make a first commit before it can start. `-C` also lets a controller review a worktree without a `cd … ;` prefix that Claude Code can't allowlist. Thanks @abat-kek, @rz1989s, and @jiyimeta for the reports. (#2429, #2242, #1799, #2606)
- **The skills say to run the helpers by absolute path from your working tree.** They used to say "from this skill's directory", and agents that `cd`'d there ran the helpers against the plugin's own files. A test now fails if a skill names a helper by a relative path. Thanks @anchore-jesset for the report. (#2525, #2607)
- **`task-brief` finds tasks with I

claude-mem.body:
## What's new

**Devin support.** `npx claude-mem install` can now set up Devin CLI and Devin Desktop: hooks are written for you, Devin's tool names are understood, and the memory search tools are registered. (#5172, #5276 by @patrickballard and @ssthormess)

**My Work refresh on your terms.** My Work and Past Focus have a "Refresh now" button (#5249 by @Kirat0201). New settings choose the refresh model per provider: `CLAUDE_MEM_WORK_VIEW_CLAUDE_MODEL`, `CLAUDE_MEM_WORK_VIEW_CODEX_MODEL` and `CLAUDE_MEM_WORK_VIEW_GEMINI_MODEL` (#5236 by @LucianVane).

**Remote workers.** New `CLAUDE_MEM_WORKER_URL` setting. A bad value fails with a clear error instead of falling back, and any worker that isn't on your own machine must use https. (#5285 by @Kirat0201)

## Privacy and security

- Turning off error reporting now also stops errors already saved on disk from being sent. (#5272 by @thedotmack)
- More secrets are redacted before they are stored: Slack and Discord webhook URLs, Stripe webhook secrets, PyPI, SendGrid, DigitalOcean, Shopify, Docker Hub and GitLab tokens, Basic credentials after Authorization headers, and CLI flags like `--auth-token` and `--client-secret`. (#5277, #5207, #5204, #5224, #5222, #5197 by @kevin9327; #5205 by @parveen0029)
- Other websites running on localhost can no longer send writes to the worker through the work-state, dedup, corpus and advisor routes. (#5200 by @DeryFerd)
- The Kimi config backup is now readable only by you. (#5290 by @patrickballard)

## Fixes you may notice

**Memory and search**
- Switching observer providers mid-conversation no longer duplicates observations. (#5227 by @liuyinchu)
- Repeated turn summaries no longer pile up. (#5228 by @Dev-0710)
- The transcript watcher no longer loses an end-of-session summary it could not queue. (#5246 by @liuyinchu)
- File searches match whichever way the path separators are written, `src/a.ts` or `src\a.ts`. (#5214 by @rudycelekli)
- All-digit `dateStart` and `dateEnd` search values are read as epoch milliseconds. (#5234 by @vinirib)
- Restarting the worker during a Chroma rebuild no longer embeds finished documents again. (#5238 by @vinirib)
- Corpora built for merged projects keep the adopted memories, and a failed rebuild no longer loses the saved corpus. (#5235 by @liuyinchu; #5291 by @rudycelekli)
- Observations with a stray closing tag on the type are still read, and batches survive verification holds. (#5221 by @Montinou; #5252 by @Kirat0201)
- Context refresh keeps marker examples you wrote yourself, and CLAUDE.md generation checks duplicate path segments only from the project folder down. (#5203 by @rudycelekli; #5232 by @vinirib)

**My Work and viewer**
- Reviews a few characters over a limit no longer fail the whole refresh, and oversized reviews recover after one retry. (#5230 by @juelpb; #5286 by @Kirat0201)
- My Work no longer slows other worker requests on large databases, and saving rules or focus rebuilds the view once instead of twice. (#5284 by @Kirat0201; #5239 by @LucianVane)
- Viewer filters keep case-variant sessions in project filters and selected categories at zero count. (#5213, #5215 by @rudycelekli)

**Importing history and token usage**
- Claude transcripts with whitespace in their JSON are no longer skipped. (#5289 by @rudycelekli)
- Codex and Gemini prompts are no longer imported twice, and legacy Gemini usage is no longer counted twice across migrated copies. (#5292, #5217, #5295 by @rudycelekli)
- Token usage stays partial instead of failing when one transcript source can't be read. (#5294 by @rudycelekli)

**Providers and accounts**
- Worker recycles are no longer reported as authentication failures. (#5278 by @2023Anita)
- macOS: the worker retries the login keychain directly and gives better diagnostics when a credential lookup fails. This may not fix every case in #5250. (#5258 by @Kirat0201)
- OpenRouter: endpoints that require reasoning no longer lose the batch; the request is resent once without the setting. (#5267 by @markjoin123)
- A rejected overage bucket on a request that was served is no longer treated as a refusal. (#5223 by @beckman55)

**Install and CLI**
- `npx claude-mem adopt --help` and `npx claude-mem cleanup --help` now print help. Before, they ran the command. Not fixed yet: the `claude-mem` launcher on your PATH still runs them, so use `npx` to read their help. (#5288 by @WhitePepperLambSoup)
- macOS 27: a launcher the OS killed is rebuilt instead of being kept as foreign. (#5253 by @REI-330)
- Windows: launcher installs retry short file locks, and npm's `claude.exe` is used instead of the sh shim. (#5256 by @HoneyTyagii; #5198 by @balabommablock-cpu)
- Codex: `CODEX_HOME` is respected, and quoted TOML settings are updated correctly. (#5216, #5212 by @rudycelekli)
- T3 Code: default Claude and Codex providers are found even when T3 never saved them. (#5283 by @balabommablock-cpu)
- OpenCode: expected registry-only setup calls no longer warn. (#5264 by @Bl0ck154)
- Hermes: the cached project key for a checkout now expires, so it can't go stale. (#5287 by @DeryFerd)
- `claude-md:regenerate` reads the database from `CLAUDE_MEM_DATA_DIR`. (#5210 by @Bortlesboat)

## For developers and hosted users

- Server-mode hooks send `contentSessionId` on semantic injection. (#5281 by @rich-murphey)
- Claude observer per-turn token usage is now logged. (#5293 by @Kirat0201)
- Claude Duet cloud sessions that can't reach cmem.ai are pointed at the Claude-Mem connector. (#5243 by @thedotmack)
- CI and test improvements. (#5201, #5202 by @DeryFerd; #5254, #5257 by @xunguangzlj-cloud)
- Chinese README terminology updates. (#5208 by @SaigyoujYuyuko)

## Thank you

This release is mostly community work. Thanks to @rudycelekli, @Kirat0201, @kevin9327, @vinirib, @DeryFerd, @patrickballard, @liuyinchu, @LucianVane, @balabommablock-cpu, @xunguangzlj-cloud, @ssthormess, @rich-murphey, @2023Anita, @WhitePepperLambSoup, @markjoin123, @Bl0ck154, @HoneyTyagii, @REI-330, @Dev-0710, @parveen0029, @beckman55, @juelpb, @Montinou, @Bortlesboat and @SaigyoujYuyuko.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/thedotmack/claude-mem/compare/v15.8.3...v15.9.0
